content:
Platforms: Windows
This event is sent when Falcon has detected that a scheduled task has been removed from the machine. The data will indicate the initial process (command-line
tool, custom utility, or GUI application) or remote address/hostname that resulted in this action. Note that the context here is not sufficient to determine full
details on the task being removed (that is captured in ScheduledTaskRegistered), but does show the task name and originator info.
